你的朋友很多嗎？是走到哪都能交朋友的「社交型」，還是朋友不多，但每一個都很知心？👭💬
聊到「朋友」，除了 I have many friends.，還可以怎麼說得更自然、更有內容？
這一集從超好聊的生活話題開始：
💬 Do you have a lot of friends?
你有很多朋友嗎？
一起學會怎麼用英文聊「朋友多不多」、「朋友對我的重要性」，還有「知心好友」與「酒肉朋友」怎麼說！
💬 A. EXERCISE｜實戰演練
Question: Do you have a lot of friends?
• Yes, quite a few. I have friends from all walks of life. Friends play an important role in my life. I like to socialize with all people around me, and that's why I have many friends. Of course, some of them are only casual friends. Like my friends at work, but I also have some intimate friends.
• Not a lot, but I have a few very close friends. I believe it is better to have some faithful friends than a thousand fair-weather friends. I like friends with whom I share some similarities, though it's not easy to meet someone you have a lot in common with.
✨ B. LANGUAGE FOCUS｜學習焦點
1. That's why + S + V …
• That's why I have many friends.
• That's why I'm telling you.
👉 用來表達「那就是為什麼……／所以才……」，很適合在口說時進一步解釋原因與結果。
2. I believe it is better to + V …
• I believe it is better to have some faithful friends than a thousand fair-weather friends.
• I believe it is better to tell the truth than to lie.
👉 想表達自己的看法或價值觀，可以用這個句型說「我認為……會比較好」。
📚 C. WORDS & PHRASES｜詞彙片語
quite a few /kwaɪt ə fjuː/ (phr.) 相當多；不少
（後接可數名詞）
all walks of life /ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf/ (idiom.) 各行各業；各個社會階層
play a …. role in /pleɪ ə roʊl ɪn/ (phr.) 扮演……角色
socialize (with) /ˈsoʊʃəlaɪz/ (v.) 社交，交際
casual /ˈkæʒuəl/ (adj.) 隨意的；（衣服）休閒的
intimate /ˈɪnt̬əmət/ (adj.) 親密的
faithful /ˈfeɪθfəl/ (adj.) 忠誠的；忠實的
fair-weather friend /ˌferˌweðɚ ˈfrend/ (n.) 酒肉朋友
similarity /ˌsɪməˈlerət̬i/ (n.) 類似；相似
have … in common /hæv ɪn ˈkɑːmən/ (phr.) 有共同處

🌟 本集學習重點
✔️ quite a few 看起來有 few，其實意思是「相當多、很多」，別搞反囉！
✔️ 用 That's why + S + V … 說明「所以這就是為什麼……」，讓口說回答更有邏輯。
✔️ 用 I believe it is better to + V … 表達自己的觀點，讓回答不只停留在 Yes / No。
✔️ 學會 fair-weather friend「酒肉朋友」和 have … in common「有共同之處」等實用說法，聊友情時更自然。
🎧 朋友真的越多越好嗎？還是幾個真正懂你的朋友就夠了？學完這一集，也試著用英文回答：
